boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Joseph's University - Philadelphia
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food and convenience stops on the City Avenue side of Hawk Hill and nearby Philadelphia, all with directly listed late availability.

cards.title: Wendy’s on City Line Ave
cards.subtitle: 259 City Line Ave, Merion Station
cards.notes: Use the official location page before heading out; it lists this City Line Avenue restaurant and its daily 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby hot-food stop with the latest verified daily closing time in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 259 City Line Ave restaurant as open 6:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s CITY LINE AVE in Merion Station, PA
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Chipotle at City Avenue
cards.subtitle: 4030 City Ave, Philadelphia
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or counter order before the listed 10 p.m. close; the official page identifies this as the City Avenue location.
cards.short_summary: A customizable dinner option on the City Avenue retail stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 4030 City Avenue restaurant hours as 10:45 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily restaurant hours through 10:00 p.m.; pickup is available during store hours.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A City Ave
cards.subtitle: 4040 City Ave, Philadelphia
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving: this City Avenue restaurant lists later Friday–Saturday availability and is closed Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A City Avenue counter-service stop with verified 11 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A City Ave lists hours until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in, carry-out, and delivery through 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Fuki Sushi & Ramen
cards.subtitle: 4600 City Ave, Philadelphia
cards.notes: For a later dinner, use the restaurant’s ordering page and note the listed Friday and Saturday 10:30 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A City Avenue sushi and ramen destination with later weekend ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuki Sushi’s online ordering page lists 10:30 p.m. closing on Friday and Saturday, with 9:45 p.m. closing on other days.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s ordering page lists hours through 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 9:45 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Larry’s Steaks
cards.subtitle: 2457 N 54th St, Philadelphia
cards.notes: Use the shop’s own visit information to confirm the day’s service, then arrive before its posted 10 p.m. daily close.
cards.short_summary: A long-running cheesesteak shop just off the City Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Larry’s Steaks lists its Philadelphia shop at 2457 N 54th St as open daily from 11:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Larry’s official site lists daily hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. for its 54th Street shop.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies Bala Cynwyd
cards.subtitle: 199 City Ave, Bala Cynwyd
cards.notes: This bakery is positioned on City Avenue near Hawk Hill; check its official location page for the live ordering cutoff before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated bakery option on City Avenue for a late dessert pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ Bala Cynwyd location is at 199 City Ave and lists late-night bakery hours, including midnight or later by day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page provides the live location-specific schedule; available hours extend to midnight or later, depending on day.

cards.title: 7‑Eleven at 169 West City Avenue
cards.subtitle: 169 W City Ave, Bala Cynwyd
cards.notes: Use this all-hours City Avenue convenience stop for a simple snack or nonalcoholic drink when restaurants have closed.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience stop on the City Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 169 West City Avenue in Bala Cynwyd as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states “Open 24/7” and identifies hot foods among store features.

cards.title: 7‑Eleven at 1 East City Ave
cards.subtitle: 1 E City Ave, Bala Cynwyd
cards.notes: Keep this City Avenue convenience-store option in mind for packaged snacks, drinks, or other non-age-restricted purchases at any hour.
cards.short_summary: Another all-hours option immediately along the City Avenue commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 1 East City Ave in Bala Cynwyd as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states “Open 24/7”; choose only ordinary food and beverage purchases.

cards.title: 7‑Eleven at 101 Belmont Ave
cards.subtitle: 101 Belmont Ave, Bala Cynwyd
cards.notes: For a later convenience-store run from the Hawk Hill side, confirm the route and choose ordinary snacks or nonalcoholic drinks.
cards.short_summary: A verified 24/7 convenience destination near the City Avenue area.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 101 Belmont Ave in Bala Cynwyd as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states “Open 24/7”; choose only ordinary food and beverage purchases.

cards.title: 7‑Eleven at 4168 Ridge Avenue
cards.subtitle: 4168 Ridge Ave, Philadelphia
cards.notes: This Philadelphia location offers a clearly documented round-the-clock backup; use transit or a safe arranged ride if it is not walkable for you.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 Philadelphia convenience-store backup beyond the immediate City Avenue strip.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 4168 Ridge Avenue in Philadelphia as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states “Open 24/7”; this is not presented as walking distance from Hawk Hill.
